chunks: It is He who drove those among the people of the Book who refused to believe, from their homes for the first confrontation. You did not think that they would go away, and they imagined that their forts would protect them against God. But God came upon them from where they did not suspect, and filled their hearts with terror, so that they destroyed their homes with their own hands (or were destroyed) by the hands of believers. So take heed, O men of sight!
ai.seo_question: What happened to the Banu al-Nadir according to this verse?
ai.summary: This verse recounts the first expulsion of the Banu al-Nadir, emphasizing how their perceived security in fortifications was shattered by divine surprise. Shia exegetes highlight the phrase 'from where they did not expect' as a manifestation of God's omnipotence, serving as a spiritual lesson for the 'people of insight' to recognize that true strength lies in divine favor rather than material defenses.
